facts.fact: Algérie Éco reported on 23 September 2026 that the Bank of Algeria's Monetary and Banking Council applied regulation no. 25-02 on payment service providers, a class created under monetary and banking law no. 23-09.
facts.system: Loi n° 23-09 and Règlement n° 25-02 on payment service providers

facts.fact: Algérie Éco reported that the Council authorised Djezzy Payment Services, subsidiary of Optimum Telecom Algérie, to constitute itself as a payment service provider under regulation 25-02; Djezzy said it would pursue the licence (agrément) the regulation provides for.
facts.system: Règlement n° 25-02 on payment service providers
